title: Viveka-Insight: a cross-lingual concept graph and citation-grounded retrieval resource over the complete works of Swami Vivekananda in English and Bengali
reasoning: The paper builds a cross-lingual concept graph and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over the spiritual and philosophical works of Swami Vivekananda. It includes an evaluation of an LLM's ability to correctly extract and map spiritual and theological concepts (Vedantic vocabulary) from these religious texts, thereby directly evaluating the model's handling of a specific faith tradition's corpus.
